// NOTE: Template. Copy to appsettings.Development.json (git-ignored) and fill in. Secrets belong in user secrets, never here.

SpotifySettings.// RedirectUrl: Must EXACTLY match a redirect URI registered in the Spotify dashboard. Note the path changed to /api/auth/callback.
SpotifySettings.// DefaultMarket: GET /me no longer returns country (Spotify, Feb 2026), so the market must be configured.

Cosmos.// Endpoint: Local emulator, or your Cosmos account endpoint.
Cosmos.// Key: Emulator only. In Azure leave unset and use managed identity: dotnet user-secrets set "Cosmos:Key" "..."
Cosmos.// ThroughputRu: 1000 is the lifetime free-tier ceiling. Also cap total account throughput in the portal.

Frontend.// AllowedOrigins: CORS allowlist. Explicit origins are required because the API uses cookie credentials.

DataProtection.// KeyRingBlobUri: Azure only. Leave unset locally to use the filesystem key ring.
DataProtection.// KeyVaultKeyId: Azure only. Wraps the key ring at rest.
